title: lupinus polyphyllus var. prunophilus
intro: Lupinus polyphyllus var. prunophilus, commonly known as Lewis's lupine, is a plant species belonging to the lupine family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Lewis's lupine are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
